opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Awards vary according to project but will only exceptionally exceed £6,000 and will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000. Travel up to £2,000 per person (≤13 days) or £2,500 per person (14+ days); PhD fieldwork visits up to £5,000; Japan office up to ¥300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects. UK projects apply to UK office; Japan projects to Japan office.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding to enable UK-Japan projects that deepen mutual understanding, exchange of ideas/expertise, or lasting collaboration. Supports festivals, workshops, performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language teaching, and academic research/visits/exchange.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Up to £10,000; continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including researchers, practitioners, policy makers, managers and voluntary sector workers. Project must involve partners in both the UK and Japan. Preference to those not previously involved in UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants.
opportunities.summary: Supports exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Grants may be used for travel expenses or to contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs.
